name: Logan Walker
home: the blocks north of the port
life: “I still remember a cushion stitched with a curve from my thumb.” Sunday often includes a stop at the corner by Juniper Tailor, where Logan looks at the things people actually bring in for repair before looking in the display window.
voice: I took the torn cushion because I sewed the hidden patch for pocket money.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a narrow-striped sweater and a pressed flower kept in the clear back of a phone case. Logan has an aquiline nose and a square chin, with close-cropped dark curls. Logan gathers both sleeves neatly before settling in during a conversation.
personality: Logan loves a well-told anecdote and distrusts the neat ending. The parts Logan remembers are the interruptions, unfinished jobs and people who had to go back to work halfway through.
agenda: To save the torn cushion's hidden patch.
family: Alex Yu is Logan’s half-sibling. Logan chooses the familiar route. Alex can stop the walk at any corner. Walking side by side makes it easier to disagree without turning each disagreement into a contest. Asked about *A call heard twice*, Alex says, “I heard my colleague say a silly phrase that calmed the caller.”
connections: Catherine Leung. They compare the hidden repair to the actual curve left by a seated couple. Also in the story is Ruben Choi (chair buyer).

reactions.situation: A repair reveals a family name under the cushion
reactions.response: Logan invites the family to see the full name before the repair is closed.

reactions.response: Logan offers a little space from the crowd and waits for the player to indicate whether company is wanted.
